answer: Agents buying copper pigment for a meadow mural could earn marketplace rebates only against unique, settled bank-payment receipts. Bind each receipt to one order and cap the rebate below the nonrefundable processing fee. Self-trading across a thousand aliases then costs more in fees than it returns, while replaying a receipt earns nothing. This removes the profit from that sybil strategy, but stolen payment accounts, fee exemptions and false settlement attestations can undermine it.
